title: The retryable statuses read as an exit code other than either 0 or a signal
resolution: The requirement and the proposal now name a status that is a signal or an exit code other than 0.

title: The unknown exit scenario had no observation-level integration test in the regular gate
resolution: Added an integration test where a delegated child exits unknown after a proven start: one attempt, an exited outcome, the delegation closed; it fails on the old predicate.

title: The safe-to-retry conflict with the supervisor identity contract was recorded only as a limitation
resolution: The design names the resource-admission requirement next to contract section 13 and the coordinator's follow-up change; verification lists the follow-up under remaining gates.
